objectives.name: Flipper
objectives.description: Buy low, sell high. Flip at least 3 cars for profit within the game.

objectives.name: Lemon Seller
objectives.description: Sell a car with an unregistered or invalid inspection hash without disclosure.

objectives.name: Launderer
objectives.description: Use the Mixer to obscure the origin of funds across at least 2 epochs.

objectives.name: Builder
objectives.description: Create and deploy a StudentToken via TokenFactory. Grow its liquidity.

objectives.name: Detective
objectives.description: Identify and report a lemon car or rug pull before it harms others.

objectives.name: Whale
objectives.description: Accumulate the highest balance among all players by game end.

objectives.name: Insurer
objectives.description: Purchase insurance and successfully file a valid claim.

objectives.name: Rug Puller
objectives.description: Create a drainable token, attract liquidity, then drain it.

objectives.name: Auditor
objectives.description: Discover a drainable token via storage slot inspection before it is drained.

objectives.name: Broker
objectives.description: Complete at least 3 successful P2P escrows via the Marketplace.

objectives.name: Market Maker
objectives.description: List at least 5 cars and facilitate 3+ sales as a seller.

objectives.name: Survivor
objectives.description: Avoid being slashed, frozen, or liquidated. Finish with positive balance.
